description: Rotate a compromised or expiring secret/token and update all of its consumers

secret_name.description: Name of the secret/token being rotated (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PIPELINE_GH_TOKEN)

reason.description: Why rotation is needed (exposure, scheduled expiration, scope change, etc.)

steps.title: Update every consumer of {{secret_name}} with the new value (1Password Environment, GitHub Actions secret, local .env / op run wiring)
Verify {{secret_name}} works end-to-end (local dev via op run, scheduled pipeline run, production deploy)
Revoke/delete the old {{secret_name}} value everywhere it was stored
